debug_download_logs_description: This downloads all MyParcel logs to a .zip file. When you contact support, you may be asked to provide this file.
debug_refresh_description: This will refresh the MyParcel account data that is stored locally. This includes which carriers are available and which permissions your account has.
debug_switch_to_acceptance_api_descripti: This switches to the acceptance API for testing purposes.
debug_switch_to_production_api_descripti: This switches back to the production API for testing purposes.
delivery_options_delivery_title: Delivery at home or at work
delivery_options_pickup_title: Pick up at a pick-up point
error_invalid_api_key_content: Please check if you have entered the correct API key.
feature_allow_show_delivery_date_descrip: Shows delivery date at the options during checkout. When set to off, morning and evening delivery are not available.
hint_enable_order_mode_backoffice: To use this option, enable order mode in the MyParcel Backoffice. When enabled, click on the 'manual update' button.
save_customer_address_description: Switch this toggle on to automatically save address details of customers that place an order.
setting_carrier_cut_off_time_description: Time at which you stop processing orders for the day (format: hh:mm)
setting_carrier_delivery_days_window_des: Amount of days a customer can postpone a shipment.
setting_carrier_digital_stamp_descriptio: Price depends on weight. Is weight filled in correctly for all products? Choose 'No default weight' to let MyParcel calculate the right weight. Select a default weight if weight is not correctly filled in for every product.
setting_carrier_drop_off_days_descriptio: Days of the week on which you hand over parcels to %s
setting_carrier_drop_off_delay_descripti: Number of days you need to process an order.
setting_change_status_after_description: Change the order status after export or after printing the shipping label.
setting_country_of_origin_description: Country of origin is required for world shipments. Defaults to shop base.
setting_export_automatic_status_descript: Creates a shipment in MyParcel when the status of an order changes. Make sure to check 'Process shipments directly' to receive the barcode.
setting_modus_description: When activated, MyParcel will export the complete order including all details to the MyParcel Backoffice. Be aware of the fact that barcodes will not be shown in order notes, so don't use this option in combination with Channable for example.
setting_show_delivery_day_description: This option allows your customers to see the delivery date in order confirmations and My Account.
settings_account_api_key_description: Paste your API key from the MyParcel Backoffice here.

settings_carrier_allow_delivery_type_exp: Can only be used in the Netherlands
settings_carrier_allow_express_delivery_: Can only be used in the Netherlands
settings_carrier_allow_pickup_locations_: Allow your customers to choose to ship their order to a pickup location.
settings_carrier_cutoff_time_description: The time you stop processing orders for the day.
settings_carrier_delivery_day_descriptio: To allow :delivery_day delivery, :cutoff_day must be present in :delivery_days, and the cut-off time must be 15:00 or earlier.
settings_carrier_delivery_days_window_de: Amount of delivery days in the future the customer can choose from.
settings_carrier_delivery_moments_descri: Choose the delivery moments your customers can choose from during checkout.
settings_carrier_delivery_options_descri: Choose the delivery options you want to offer to your customers during checkout.
settings_carrier_delivery_options_pickup: Choose whether you want to show pickup location options to your customers.
settings_carrier_digital_stamp_default_w: Default weight of a digital stamp
settings_carrier_drop_off_delay_descript: Number of days you need to process an order.
settings_carrier_drop_off_possibilities_: Choose the days you hand in packages to the carriers and the last order moment.
settings_carrier_export_description: Choose the default export settings for your shipments.
settings_carrier_export_insurance_price_: Use percentage of total order amount for insurance. After the calculation, the next available price scale is selected.
settings_carrier_export_insurance_up_to_: This setting applies to domestic shipments only.
Insure orders up to (EU + Rest of World)

settings_carrier_export_return_large_for: Enable larger than 100 x 70 x 58 cm
settings_carrier_export_returns_title_de: These settings apply to return shipments only.

settings_carrier_price_international_mai: This price will be used when a mailbox package is shipped to a location outside of the Netherlands or Belgium.
settings_carrier_shipment_options_descri: Choose the shipment options you allow your customers to choose from during checkout.
settings_checkout_allowed_shipping_metho: Select the shipping methods with which you want to link the MyParcel delivery options. This must be filled in to show delivery options in the checkout.
settings_checkout_delivery_options_custo: Custom CSS for the delivery options
settings_checkout_delivery_options_descr: Options related to the delivery options on the checkout page.
settings_checkout_delivery_options_heade: This text will appear above the delivery options.
settings_checkout_display_for_descriptio: You can link the delivery options to specific shipping methods by adding them to the package types in "Standard export settings". The delivery options are not visible for foreign addresses.
settings_checkout_enable_address_widget_: When enabled, Dutch addresses use the MyParcel address service to automatically autocomplete the address based on postal code / house number
settings_checkout_enable_delivery_option: If on, delivery options will also be shown if the products in the checkout are not in stock.
settings_checkout_export_insurance_price: When exporting orders, the insurance price will be calculated by multiplying the insurance price factor with the order total.
settings_checkout_allow_pickup_locations: Allow users to switch between list and map
Allow users to choose between a list or map view of pickup locations.
settings_checkout_pickup_locations_defau: Default view for the pickup locations
settings_checkout_price_type_description: Whether the price for delivery is included in the total price.
settings_checkout_show_delivery_day_desc: Show the delivery day on the checkout page
settings_checkout_string_signature_descr: Enable this option if the recipient has to sign for the delivery.
settings_checkout_use_separate_address_f: When enabled, the address fields will be split into separate fields.
settings_customs_country_of_origin_descr: Select the general country of origin. You can adjust this per individual product.
settings_customs_customs_code_descriptio: Select the general customs code. You can adjust this per individual product.
settings_customs_package_contents_descri: Select the package contents. You can adjust this for each individual product.
settings_label_defaults_description: These are the default values that will applied when printing shipments.
settings_label_description_subtext:
Available variables:
[DELIVERY_DATE]: Delivery date
[ORDER_ID]: Order number
[PRODUCT_ID]: Product ID
[PRODUCT_NAME]: Product name
[PRODUCT_QTY]: Product quantity
[PRODUCT_SKU]: Product SKU
[CUSTOMER_NOTE]: Customer note
settings_label_direct_print_description: Immediately creates a label and prints it on your configured printer group when a shipment is exported.
settings_label_output_description: Select the default behavior when a label is created.
settings_label_position_description: Select the default position(s) of the label(s) on an A4 page.
settings_label_prompt_description: Shows a prompt before printing a label, allowing you to choose format, output and position.

settings_order_empty_mailbox_weight: Base weight of a mailbox package (g)

settings_order_status_on_label_create_de: Select the order status that should be used when a label is created.
settings_order_status_when_delivered_des: Select the order status that should be used when a shipment is delivered.
settings_order_status_when_label_scanned: Select the order status that should be used when a label is scanned.

shipment_options_age_check_subtext_postn: When using PostNL, signature and only recipient are required while 18+ check is enabled.
shipment_options_insured_amount_descript: Insure all parcels up to the selected amount.
shipment_options_insured_description: By default, there is no insurance on the shipments. If you still want to insure the shipment, you can do that. We insure the purchase value of the shipment, with a maximum insured value of € 5.000. Insured parcels always contain the options 'Home address only' en 'Signature for delivery'
shipment_options_insured_from_price_desc: Insure all orders that exceed this price point.
shipment_options_large_format_descriptio: Enable this option when your shipment is bigger than 100 x 70 x 50 cm, but smaller than 175 x 78 x 58 cm. An extra fee will be charged. Note! If the parcel is bigger than 175 x 78 x 58 of or heavier than 30 kg, the pallet rate will be charged.
shipment_options_large_format_from_weigh: Enter the weight in grams from which the Large package setting should be activated.
shipment_options_only_recipient_descript: If you don't want the parcel to be delivered at the neighbours, choose this option.
shipment_options_package_type_descriptio: Choose the package type you want to use for this shipment.
shipment_options_return_description: If it is not possible to deliver a package, it will be brought to a PostNL location where the recipient can pick up the package. If you prefer the package to be returned immediately instead of to a collection point, you can turn on the Return if no answer. This is mainly used for packages with perishable contents or very expensive products.
shipment_options_same_day_delivery_descr: Switch on to use the 'Same day delivery' option.
shipment_options_signature_description: The parcel will be offered at the delivery address. If the recipient is not at home, the parcel will be delivered to the neighbours. In both cases, a signature will be required.
track_trace_link: You can track your order with the following Track & Trace link:
return_shipment_created_description: The return shipment has been created successfully.
shipment_options_cooled_delivery_descrip: Ship temperature-sensitive products that must remain cooled during transport.
shipment_options_fresh_food_description: Ship fresh food products that need to stay cool during transport.
shipment_options_frozen_description: Ship frozen products that must stay below freezing during transport.
shipment_options_hide_sender_description: Hide your business address from the parcel label. The parcel will be sent using the MyParcel return address instead.
shipment_options_insurance_description: Insure the parcel against loss or damage during transport up to the selected amount.
shipment_options_oversized_package_descr: Enable this option when your shipment is bigger than 100 x 70 x 50 cm, but smaller than 175 x 78 x 58 cm. An extra fee will be charged. Note! If the parcel is bigger than 175 x 78 x 58 of or heavier than 30 kg, the pallet rate will be charged.
shipment_options_priority_delivery_descr: Have the parcel handled with priority for faster transit to the recipient.
shipment_options_recipient_only_delivery: If you don't want the parcel to be delivered at the neighbours, choose this option.
shipment_options_requires_age_verificati: Restrict delivery to recipients aged 18 or older. The carrier verifies the recipient's age with a valid ID before handing over the parcel.
shipment_options_requires_receipt_code_d: The recipient must enter a unique code received by email or SMS before the parcel is handed over. Adds an extra layer of security on delivery.
shipment_options_requires_signature_desc: The parcel will be offered at the delivery address. If the recipient is not at home, the parcel will be delivered to the neighbours. In both cases, a signature will be required.
shipment_options_return_on_first_failed_: If it is not possible to deliver a package, it will be brought to a PostNL location where the recipient can pick up the package. If you prefer the package to be returned immediately instead of to a collection point, you can turn on the Return if no answer. This is mainly used for packages with perishable contents or very expensive products.
shipment_options_saturday_delivery_descr: Have the parcel delivered on Saturday. Orders must be placed before the Friday cut-off time.
shipment_options_scheduled_collection_de: The carrier picks up the parcel at the sender's address instead of the sender dropping it off at a service point.
shipment_options_tracked_description: Track and trace the parcel throughout its journey to the recipient.
settings_product_fit_in_digital_stamp: Size and weight suitable for Digital Stamp
capabilities_cleared_field_reverted: Choice was reverted as this combination is not possible for this carrier. Change other options for this shipment and try again.
capabilities_cleared_field_cleared: Choice was removed as this combination is not possible for this carrier. Change other options for this shipment and try again.
capabilities_cleared_option_cleared: Option deselected, this option cannot be used for this shipment with the given destination, carrier, package type and/or delivery type.
shipment_options_no_tracking_description: Disables track & trace for this parcel. The recipient cannot follow its journey.
